entries.title: The intro moved to its own page
entries.body: The landing page used to fade in the intro text and the menu once the scroll was over, all on the same page. They now live on a dedicated page that the torus navigates to at the end of the scroll, with a cross-fade between the two. The description types itself in, word by word, the same way project descriptions do in the gallery.

entries.title: UI polish
entries.body: Glassmorphism on the sprite tooltip, a resizable hand preview, and a redesigned camera button.

entries.title: Gallery menu and hand tracking fixes
entries.body: Added the menu that swaps the gallery dataset, and ironed out the rough edges of the hand tracking.

entries.title: Hand tracking with MediaPipe
entries.body: Pinch to rotate the gallery. MediaPipe loads from a CDN at runtime, so there is nothing to install and nothing to build.

entries.title: The browse gallery
entries.body: Projects laid out as sprites along a curved line, with snap navigation and a table of contents on the right.
